description: This file contains utility functions for making API requests, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and RTK Query endpoints, for a web application related to user profiles, challenges, exams, donations, and certificates.

classes.name: ResponseWithData
classes.description: Generic interface representing an API response containing data of type T.

classes.name: Attempt
classes.description: Represents an exam attempt with status and result details.

classes.name: Exam
classes.description: Represents an exam with id and configuration.

classes.name: ExamTokenResponse
classes.description: Response structure for exam token API.

classes.name: Cert
classes.description: Represents a certificate with title, username, date, and completion time.

classes.name: Donation
classes.description: Structure for donation data sent to API.

methods.name: getCSRFToken
methods.description: Retrieves CSRF token from cookies if in browser environment.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API path.

methods.name: combineDataWithResponse
methods.description: Combines fetch response with parsed JSON data.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified API path.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the specified API path.

methods.name: deleteRequest
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified API path.

methods.name: parseApiResponseToClientUser
methods.description: Converts API user response to client User object.

methods.name: mapFilesToChallengeFiles
methods.description: Maps API challenge files to client challenge files.

methods.name: mapKeyToFileKey
methods.description: Converts API file keys to client fileKey property.
